claim: Hunter test requires entering chatroom where only one person can take the test at a time
value: Only one person can take the test at a time
quote: You need to be in the chatroom to even qualify to take the test, and you cannot leave. Only one person can take the test at a time

claim: Hunter test requires killing 4 Job Change Monsters in the form of Poring, Zombie, Archer Skeleton, or Mummy
quote: What the test actually is, is you get teleported to a room and need to kill 4 different monsters. These monsters are called "Job Change Monster" and will take the form of a Poring, Zombie, Archer Skeleton, or Mummy.

claim: Hunter test kicks player out if killing monsters with names like Hunter Change Monster or Job Test Monster
quote: If you kill anything witn a different name such as "Hunter Change Monster" or "Job Test Monster", you will be kicked out and have to start over.

claim: Hunter test arena contains traps on tiles that look like they have water in them
quote: You should also be very carful while walking through the room as there are traps set. You can tell if a tile is a trap because they look like they have water in them.

claim: Hunter test center switch gives option escape with 3 minutes to exit
quote: Talk to the switch and it will give you some options, choose "escape". You will now have 3 minutes to exit the map from the opposite side in whuch you came in.

claim: Hunter test reward is a necklace given to front desk lady to complete class change
quote: Once you're done, talk to the Hunter again and you will recieve a necklace. Give this necklace to the lady at the front desk, and yay! You're a Hunter!
